text:
sarah: FYI invoice-preview showed ~+1.8% for a cohort of EU tenants this morning; not reflected in main billing dashboard yet
mike: noticed an uptick of late-arrival events in the metering consumer around 02:05 UTC after last night's connector deploy
anita: which deploy? the priority-queue connector tweak?
jon: yes, that one. we changed ack flow: ack_on_enqueue -> ack_on_commit and added a tiny retry/backoff; i was worried about watermark semantics
mike: local repro: slow downstream + new ack semantics => reordering. preview aggregator ends up counting late events into current hour
anita: root cause looks like dedupe id (fingerprint) isn't populated until commit path in some code paths. earlier enqueue has blank dedupe -> treated as distinct event later
sarah: short-term ask: can we hide obvious late arrivals from invoice-preview to reduce noise to finance?
mike: propose a conservative preview filter: exclude events where ingest_latency_ms > 30_000 from preview calculations. canary 5% tenants. will emit metric preview_filter_applied_total
jon: longer term we should materialize a stable dedupe_id at the proxy/edge before enqueue so retries can't create separate fingerprints
anita: i'll start a fingerprinting refactor PR and add unit + integration tests that simulate reordering and duplicate-enqueue cases
sarah: also want a 'preview_confidence' field in Console and a tooltip explaining filters and expected divergence vs final invoices
finance-bot: reminder: preview filters must not affect final invoice generation. include runbook link when you post
mike: opening hotfix PR for preview filter now (github.com/redwood/hotfixes/preview-filter)
deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/preview-filter -> staging
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: hotfix/preview-filter to staging (build 5499)
mike: staged canary for 5% tenants, monitoring preview_delta and late_event_rate graphs
jon: i'll add a small Billing Preview card showing preview_confidence (green/orange/red) and example suppressed events for transparency
sarah: create alert: billing.preview_delta > 1% sustained 15m -> #eng-oncall + #finance-watch and link runbook for triage
anita: note for Dedicated customers: migration requires envelope change (dedupe_id required). i'll draft migration notes and compatibility plan
mike: aside: we should run a nightly recon job to compute late-arrival corrections and emit an invoice_correction_estimate metric for transparency
sarah: plan summary: 1) hotfix preview filter -> canary 5% 2) fingerprint refactor to materialize dedupe earlier 3) Console preview_confidence and tooltip 4) alerts + runbook 5) nightly reconciliation job
jon: pairing anita + me on dashboard copy tomorrow. will also add metric preview_filter_applied_total to billing metrics
mike: PRs: hotfix preview-filter #14, fingerprint-refactor #48
sarah: thanks team. keep finance/product in the loop. will close this thread once staging canary looks stable
